ON THE 20 th OF FEBRUARY, 2023  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 4041 of 2023  BETWEEN:-
 SURENDRA SINGH THAKUR S/O SHRI PHOOL SINGH THAKUR,
 AGED ABOUT 50 YEARS, OCCUPATION: DRIVER, R/O FOREST  COLONY, DEVDARA, MANDLA, DISTRICT MANDLA (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI SHREYAS PANDIT - ADVOCATE)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE STATION  MANDLA, DISTRICT MANDLA (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI D.K. PAROHA - PANEL LAWYER )
 T h is application coming on for admission this day, the Cour  following:
 ORDER
This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail.
T h e applicant apprehends his arrest in connection with Crime No.27/2023 registered at Police Station Mandla, District Mandla for the offence punishable under Sections 376 and 506 of IPC.
The allegation against the present applicant is that he sexually exploited the prosecutrix.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that as per the allegation made against him, the act was committed on 23.10.2022, however the FIR was lodged after a period of nearly two months in the month of January 2023.
It is stated that the prosecutrix is in the habit of making such kind of allegations against different persons to extract money.

He has referred to the documents filed along Surendra Singh Thakur vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109710284/
1 with this application which are the complaint and 164 statement made by the prosecutrix earlier against one Assistant District Excise Officer Jitendra Alawa.

entities.text: Surendra Singh Thakur vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Referring to these documents it is pointed out that earlier also a complaint was made against one Jitendra Alawa but later on she turned hostile.
He further submits that the applicant is a government servant, and in case if he is arrested, his entire future would be spoiled and prays that he may be enlarged on bail.
He is ready to abide by all the conditions as may be imposed by this Court.

Considering the documents on record which are not disputed by the learned counsel for the State and the fact that the prosecutrix is a mature lady of 36 years of age and the complaint has been lodged after a period of two months of the alleged incident, this application is allowed.

It is directed that in the event of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rs. Fifty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of arresting officer.

(NANDITA DUBEY) JUDGE ak Surendra Singh Thakur vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109710284/
2
